profile.headline: HIL Software engineer at Ford Motor Company
profile.summary:
•	Mechanical engineer with Master of Science degree in mechanical engineering.
•	FEA Engineer experienced in Design and Analysis of Automobile Engine mounts and rubber isolators.
•	Well-versed with Static linear and non-linear analysis, Dynamic analysis, Optimizations and fatigue Analysis.
•	7 years of experience using commercial FEA software like ABAQUS, Hypermesh, Optistruct and Nastran.
•	Strong Programming skills using Languages such as Matlab, VBA, FORTRAN, C, etc.

positions.title: Senior CAE Engineer
positions.description:
CAE simulations of Plastic components. including Isotropic and anisotropic FEA and durability analysis.
Acoustic simulation. 
Moldflow analysis.

positions.title: Senior FEA Analyst
positions.description:
Developed durability prediction software using Python and FORTRAN, capable of performing fatigue analysis of Single and multi-channel (RLD) Road Load Data for non-linear material.
	
Concept design and FEA analysis of various automotive NVH and sealing products to meet static/dynamic performance as per DVP&R requirements.

Processing of road load data using nCode/GlyphWorks for signal reduction, block cycle creation and durability prediction 

Carry out physical testing to ensure proper FEA correlation and manage product database

Prepared and delivered training courses on advanced FEA simulation techniques for rubber parts
Simulation Capabilities:
	Static linear and non-linear analysis for metals, plastic and rubber products
	Quasi-Static simulation for complicated rubber products
	Modal analysis, Frequency response (FRF) and Random response analysis.
	Topology optimization 
	Strong Hex meshing skills with complicated rubber geometries, Tetra-meshing and 2D/3D shell meshing

positions.title: FEA Analyst
positions.description:
•	Preparing rubber fatigue life calculation software using fracture mechanics based approach for improved service life prediction using Python.
•	Design and analysis of rubber isolators to meet dynamic and static performance and durability requirements.
•	Preparing material database by characterizing rubber compounds for durability, hyperplastic, viscoelastic properties
•	Preparing standard procedures and guidelines for performing FEA analysis.
•	Providing hypermesh and abaqus training specifically designed for rubber analysis to colleagues

positions.title: FEA Analyst
positions.description:
> Design and analysis of Engine and chassis mounts for Dynamic and Static requirements.
> Optimization of metals brackets for better performance with reduced cost using Optistruct.
> Analyzing the damping characteristics of rubber and fluid for damping characteristics and durability of the mount to meet the customer requirements.

positions.title: Engineering Analyst
positions.description: Linear and non-linear analysis experience of metal structures for large mining equipment, Forestry equipment, and off road vehicles Using Abaqus, Nastran, Hypermesh, etc.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Quasi-static and Dynamic impact loading analysis of composite materials 
Simulation of impact induced damage of nanocomposites 
Developed 3D FEA codes with isotropic and anisotropic hyperelastic nonlinear material models on Fortran
Investigated effects of graphite inclusions on the constitutive and failure properties of steel 
Implemented nonlinear multiphysics formulation capable of simulating Thermal-mechanical systems and intercalation induced stresses.   
Simulated the fracture and fatigue analysis of composite materials using  Ortiz-Pandolfi cohesive zone model
Prepared 3D mesh generators for FEA using Matlab.

positions.title: Design Engineer
positions.description:
Design Of Air Cooled Heat Exchangers.
•	Thermal, Mechanical and Structural design of Air Cooled Heat Exchangers (ACHE) using commercial tools. 
•	Introduced Ansys for Mechanical design and STAAD pro. for structural design in the group operational for design of ACHE
•	Completed projects of HPCL Mumbai refinery up-gradation and MRPL Mangalore refinery diesel hydro treating unit during my tenure as an engineer.
•	Involved in the proposal activity for Jubail Export Refinery project, Abu Dhabi and HPCL refinery at Vizag, India for hydrogen generation unit.

publications.title: Modeling the delamination of amorphous-silicon thin film anode for lithium-ion battery
Micromechanisms of Capacity Fade in Silicon Anode for Lithium-Ion Batteries
